assertions.name: cached_trM_matches_recomputed_to_high_precision
assertions.source: Re-evaluating tr_M from the cached p_in_u / denom_in_u / shift values reproduces the cached tr_M_at_q0 to 50-dps precision — confirming the Habiro resummation is complete.

assertions.name: item_C_alone_does_NOT_close_m_p_gap
assertions.source: Full Habiro residue at A=1 (Item C) is bounded by ~0.3 MeV in T6 — far below the 1571× shortfall the m_p chain shows. Items A (T2+T3) + B (T5) carry the bulk.

description: m_p chain Item C probe — full Habiro residue at A=1 using cached habiro-coefficients-atomic.witness.json. Confirms the cached tr_M(β_atomic, q_0) IS the Habiro-resummed value (rational function in u = q^{1/2}); there is no separate residue tail to add. The T6 ~ 0.68·m_e quarantined value in derive_m_p_hecke_path_a refers to a different small-q expansion tail, bounded by ~0.3 MeV. Confirms Item C alone cannot close the 1571× m_p chain shortfall.
caveats: This probe HONESTLY reports a NEGATIVE finding: full Habiro residue at A=1 cannot close the m_p chain gap. The cached tr_M(β_atomic, q_0) is already the Habiro-resummed value and the T6 'tail' is a different small-q expansion. The remaining m_p gap must come from Items A or B (per the m_p closure audit doc).
